bugs.summary: when an export names note_ids, notes are selected by id only and the workspace filter is dropped, so a member can export any workspace's notes
bugs.repro: olivia (workspace 1) POSTs /workspaces/1/exports with note_ids=[id of a note in tom's workspace 2]; the download contains tom's note

bugs.summary: the /s/{token}/raw route does its own lookup and checks expiry and deleted note but not revoked_at, so a revoked share link still downloads the note
bugs.repro: create a share link, revoke it; GET /s/{token} -> 404 but GET /s/{token}/raw -> 200 with the note's Markdown

bugs.summary: restoring a note from the trash never checks that its workspace is live (the trash route uses require_member, not require_live_member), so a note is resurrected inside a deleted workspace and its old share links work again
bugs.repro: share a note, delete the workspace (link now 404), POST /workspaces/{ws}/trash/{note}/restore -> 200; GET /s/{token} -> 200 although the workspace is still deleted

bugs.summary: the base_version check compares against the loaded row in Python and then writes version+1 with a plain UPDATE (no WHERE version = base), so two concurrent edits from the same version both succeed and the first is lost
bugs.repro: two editors open note at version 1 and save at the same moment; both PATCH requests load version 1, both pass the check, both return 200; the final body is the second edit and the first edit is silently lost (version 2, not a 409)

bugs.summary: request_id de-duplication is a SELECT then INSERT with no unique constraint on (workspace_id, created_by, request_id), so a double click that sends two creates at once makes two notes
bugs.repro: send two POST /workspaces/{ws}/notes with the same request_id concurrently; both see no existing note and both insert; the list shows two copies

bugs.summary: cancel always moves a job to cancelling and relies on the runner to finish it, but the runner only claims queued jobs, so a job cancelled while still queued stays cancelling forever; cancelling counts as active in the one-export-per-workspace index, so no export can ever run again
bugs.repro: start an export and cancel it before the background task picks it up; run_export returns without touching it; the job shows cancelling forever, DELETE again -> 409 and every new POST /exports -> 409 already in progress

bugs.summary: the runner writes status=done from its in-memory copy at the end without re-checking, overwriting a cancel (cancelling) that arrived while it was rendering, so a cancelled export produces a downloadable file
bugs.repro: start an export of a large workspace; cancel while it renders (status cancelling); the runner then commits status=done and /download returns the file

decoys.why_correct: note lookups filter on both note id and the caller's workspace_id (from their membership), so a note id from another workspace is a 404 for show, edit, delete and restore
_claim is a conditional UPDATE queued->running with a rowcount check, so two runners for the same job cannot both run it

delete stamps the workspace and its live notes with the same deleted_at value in one transaction, and restore brings back only notes whose deleted_at equals the workspace's, so notes trashed earlier stay in the trash; the timestamp equality is exact because the same Python value is written to both
